name: Text effects
blurb: Import one onto any heading or paragraph — scramble, shimmer, split-reveal, rotating words, typewriter, scroll-lit, marker highlight, glitch, count-up.

name: Backgrounds
blurb: Aurora, interactive gradients, dot grids, constellations, meteors and spotlight grids — drop behind any hero or section.

name: Buttons & cards
blurb: Magnetic and shimmering buttons; spotlight, tilt, glow-border and flip cards that react to the pointer.

name: Navigation
blurb: A floating dock, sliding tabs, a navbar that hides on scroll, a progress bar and a scroll-spy table of contents.

name: Scroll & motion
blurb: Reveal-on-scroll, marquees, parallax, a custom cursor, pinned horizontal scroll and stacking cards.

name: Landing sections
blurb: The blocks every landing page needs: hero, bento grid, pricing, FAQ, testimonials, logos, stats, timeline and CTA.

name: Forms
blurb: Floating-label inputs, OTP entry, a password meter and a waitlist form with a ready-made API route.

name: Overlays & feedback
blurb: Accessible modal / drawer / sheet, toasts, tooltips, a cookie banner and a command palette.

name: Data & charts
blurb: Dependency-free sparklines, animated bar charts, radial progress and KPI cards for dashboards.

name: Utilities
blurb: Theme toggle with no flash, copy button, scroll-to-top, skeleton loaders and confetti.
